datasets.name: UAV remote sensing data of Jiuzhaigou County
datasets.verbatim: The authors would like to thank the Sichuan Earthquake Administration for offering the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data

datasets.name: COCO2014 data set
datasets.verbatim: The transfer learning method is used to train the weights obtained by Mask R-CNN on the official COCO2014 [48] data set as the pre-training weights of the landslides detection algorithm in this paper.

methods.name: Improved Mask R-CNN
methods.summary: An end-to-end improved Mask R-CNN model that replaces the feature extraction layer with a ResNeXt module, adds a bottom-up channel to the feature pyramid network (FPN), and incorporates an edge loss function to improve landslide boundary detection accuracy.
methods.verbatim: To solve the above problem, an end-to-end improved Mask R-CNN model was proposed. The main innovations of this paper were (1) replacing the feature extraction layer with an effective ResNeXt module to extract the landslides. (2) Increasing the bottom-up channel in the feature pyramid network to make full use of low-level positioning and high-level semantic information. (3) Adding edge losses to the loss function to improve the accuracy of the landslide boundary detection accuracy.

availability.author_statement: The data presented in this study are available on request from the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not linked or publicly available, and the custom code for the improved Mask R-CNN model lacks a repository or persistent link.
